lines.text: Wait! How Honeybees Dance to Share Secret GPS Maps!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why bees do waggle dance!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Worker honeybees perform a figure-eight waggle dance whose angle to.
the sun and wiggle duration give hive mates exact flower directions.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Bee Dance Gps!
